mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credit_facility ( facility_id, customer_id, borrower_entity, approval_date, maturity_date, credit_total_cny, used_credit_cny, available_credit_cny, current_loan_balance_cny, bank_acceptance_bill_balance_cny, guarantee_balance_cny, collateral, purpose_allowed, purpose_restrictions, covenants, reconciliation_note, evidence_ref, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{facilityId}, #{customerId}, #{borrowerEntity}, #{approvalDate}, #{maturityDate}, #{creditTotalCny}, #{usedCreditCny}, #{availableCreditCny}, #{currentLoanBalanceCny}, #{bankAcceptanceBillBalanceCny}, #{guaranteeBalanceCny}, #{collateral}, #{purposeAllowed, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{purposeRestrictions, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{covenants, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{reconciliationNote}, #{evidenceRef}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{updatedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} )
